name: WF-deepest-without-free
note: RE-AIMED (WW-C2, bible/03-World/World-Wide.md WW-C): the level thinned by the day (a province's pool) before free is asked.

name: WF-band-unasked
note: RE-AIMED (WW-C2, bible/03-World/World-Wide.md WW-C): the band thinned by the day (a province's pool) before free is asked.

name: WF-ring-for-the-two-pixel-band
why: The law as it stood is kept verbatim, and this arm of it never decides: it is read only when the pool is short of the count, and by then the floor loop has lowered the floor to 2 (or it began at 1 or 2) - so the two-pixel band IS the pool, or within it, and short too: the whole ring is taken either way. Equivalent in the old law as in this one.

name: WF-band-for-the-ring
why: The law as it stood is kept verbatim, and these passes never decide: the band's one-pixel pass fills the count whenever the band holds that many (a pixel is at least 1 from every other), and a band holding fewer was already widened to the whole ring above - so the ring's passes read the band itself, or are never reached. Equivalent in the old law as in this one.

name: WF-asked-again
note: RE-AIMED (WW-C2, bible/03-World/World-Wide.md WW-C): free asked of a cell's middle pixel.

name: WF-asked-first
old: if (ring) byRing[ring].push({ x, y, ring, bd: bd[i], free: /** @type {boolean|undefined} */ (undefined) });
new: if (ring) byRing[ring].push({ x, y, ring, bd: bd[i], free: !!free(x, y) });
